label: Planning Agent
description: A stronger AI agent for big, multi-step jobs: it writes a plan, keeps notes in files, and can hand parts of the work to helper agents. It reads and writes the conversation (`messages`). Technical: deepagents create_deep_agent.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model that does the planning and thinking. Plug in an “AI model” block.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Optional. Things the agent may use, such as a web API or your own Python function.

inputs.name: middleware
inputs.description: Optional. Add-ons that change how the agent behaves: limits, retries, safety checks.

inputs.name: subagents
inputs.description: Optional. Helper agents it can hand tasks to. Plug in “Helper Agent” blocks.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Optional. Where the agent keeps its notes and files. Without one, files last only for this run.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go when the agent has finished: connect the next step, or Finish.

system_prompt.title: Instructions for the agent
system_prompt.description: Tell the AI who it is and how to behave, in plain words, e.g. “You are a friendly support assistant. Answer briefly.”

approve_tools.title: Tools that need approval
approve_tools.description: Pause before these tools run; built-ins such as write_file or task are allowed.

approvers.title: Who may approve its tool calls
approvers.description: Leave empty to let anyone who answers the Inbox decide (and, once published, whoever calls the workflow). Naming roles, groups or people sends the decision to them only.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Members with one of these roles.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups your identity provider keeps over SCIM, by name.

caller.title: Whoever calls the published workflow may answer too
caller.description: Its deployment key, an MCP or A2A client, a share link or an event handler.

not_initiator.title: Not the person who started the run

escalate_to.title: If nobody decides in time, escalate to
escalate_to.description: Members with this role may then decide too, and are told. Unset: the run is cancelled when the approval expires.

escalate_after_hours.title: Escalate after (hours)
escalate_after_hours.description: Unset: when the approval would expire (the server's approval expiry).

response_format.title: Structured output (JSON Schema)
response_format.description: When set, the agent's final answer is validated against this schema and written to the `structured_response` channel.
